IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Clements, Kenney, Upthegrove and Strow

Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing vehicles with aftermarket hydraulic systems to operate on public roadways.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing vehicles with aftermarket hydraulicsystems to operate on public roadways; and adding a new section tochapter 46.61 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Except when lawfully participating in a parade permitted by a localjurisdiction, activation of an aftermarket hydraulic or mechanicalsystem that raises or lowers the height of a motor vehicle isprohibited unless: (1) The motor vehicle is on a public roadway witha posted speed limit of twentyfive miles per hour or less; and (2) thevehicle is traveling at a speed of fifteen miles per hour or less. Atno time may any portion of any tire of such motor vehicle leave thesurface of the roadway or may any portion of the vehicle or componentof the hydraulic system used to raise or lower the vehicle cause oremit sparks. A motor vehicle equipped with an aftermarket hydraulic ormechanical system must meet all suspension requirements outlined inthis chapter or in rules adopted by the Washington state patrol. p. 1 HB 2643Nothing in this section shall prohibit a city or county from enactingstricter regulations for aftermarket vehicle hydraulics on a publicroadway.
